notifications.title: Masala Chips 150 g · Nagpur
notifications.body: Priya ji, Nagpur godown mein Masala Chips 150g (batch MF-2409-117) ki 1,360 units 18 Nov se pehle nahi bikengi. Q-commerce block hai. Route dekhne ke liye tap karein.

feed.text: Asked Rakesh Traders for one label photo before quoting any price.

notifications.title: Ek photo chahiye
notifications.body: Rakesh bhai, Masala Chips 150g ka ek carton ka label photo bhej dein (batch MF-2409-117). Bas ek photo, baaki hum kar lenge.

feed.text: Sent one photo of the carton label from shelf B4.
Read the label: batch MF-2409-117, MFG 18 May 2026, best before 18 Nov 2026, MRP ₹30.00, confidence 0.97. Matches the DMS record.
Priced five channels against 47 days left. Destroying costs −₹19.36 a unit, −₹26,330 for the batch.
588 units to the kirana cluster at ₹18 effective, capped by what 38 kiranas can move in 14 days; 772 to ExpireSoon at ₹15. The Nagpur staff sale pays less a unit, so it gets nothing this time.
Sent Priya the plan to review, and Rakesh bhai the same plan with a pause button.

notifications.title: Plan ready · MF-2409-117
notifications.body: Plan for MF-2409-117: 588 units kirana (₹18), 772 units ExpireSoon (₹15). Net ₹21,770, ₹26,340 better than write-off. GST ITC ₹1,224 safe. Tap to review and approve.

feed.text: Approved the plan from her phone.

notifications.title: Plan approved · Masala Chips
notifications.body: Rakesh bhai, Munchly ne MF-2409-117 ka plan approve kiya: 588 packets aapke kiranas ko scheme par, 772 aapke naam se ExpireSoon par. Kuch rokna ho to app mein Pause dabayein.

feed.text: Posted 772 units on ExpireSoon in Rakesh Traders' name at ₹15, with the label photo and dates. Reserve ₹13.50; hidden from buyers inside Munchly's territories.
Pushed the Hindi scheme to 38 kiranas in the Nagpur cluster: buy 10 get 2 for 48 hours, no shop over 4× its own 14-day sales.
